KR_AI_BASIC_ACT.name: Framework Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and the Establishment of a Foundation for Trust (Korea AI Basic Act)
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT.description: Korean AI Basic Act. Key obligations for high-impact and generative AI: transparency (제31조), safety (제32조), high-impact AI confirmation (제33조), business operator duties incl. risk management, explanation, user protection, human oversight and documentation (제34조), impact assessment (제35조). At least a one-year grace period applies to fines.

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제2조.title: Definition — high-impact AI
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제2조.description: An AI system used in a domain where it may significantly affect, or pose a risk to, human life, physical safety or fundamental rights (energy, drinking water, healthcare, medical devices, nuclear power, biometric identification for criminal investigation, and judgements or assessments that materially affect individual rights and obligations such as recruitment or lending).
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제2조.evidenceHint: Record of the high-impact AI determination in the AI inventory (EV-INV)

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제31조.title: Duty to ensure AI transparency
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제31조.description: When providing high-impact or generative AI products or services, notify users in advance that the service is AI-operated, label generative AI outputs, and clearly disclose outputs such as deepfakes that are hard to distinguish from reality.
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제31조.evidenceHint: Notice/labelling UX evidence, policy documents (EV-UI, EV-POL) · Tests: T-TRANS

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제32조.title: Duty to ensure AI safety
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제32조.description: Operators of high-performance AI above a defined threshold must establish and operate a life-cycle risk identification, assessment and mitigation process plus a safety-incident monitoring and response system, and submit the results to the Minister of Science and ICT.
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제32조.evidenceHint: Risk management framework documents, safety-incident response system, submission history (EV-RISK, EV-INC, EV-PMM) · Tests: T-SAFE, T-SEC, T-ROB, T-RT

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제33조.title: Confirmation of high-impact AI
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제33조.description: Operators must review in advance whether the AI they intend to provide qualifies as high-impact AI and may request confirmation from the Minister of Science and ICT where necessary.
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제33조.evidenceHint: Records of the high-impact AI applicability review and confirmation (EV-INV, EV-DEC) · Tests: T-CONF

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제34조.title: Duties of high-impact AI business operators
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제34조.description: (1)1 establish and operate a risk management plan; (1)2 establish and implement an explanation plan covering final AI outputs, key criteria and an overview of training data; (1)3 user protection measures; (1)4 human management and oversight; (1)5 prepare and retain documentation demonstrating safety and trustworthiness measures.
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제34조.evidenceHint: Risk management plan, explanation plan, user protection plan, management/oversight structure, safety & trustworthiness documentation (EV-RISK, EV-TECHDOC, EV-COMM, EV-PROC, EV-TEST) · Tests: T-ACC, T-BIAS, T-SEC, T-HO, T-HALL

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제35조.title: AI impact assessment
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제35조.description: Endeavour to assess in advance the impact of high-impact AI products and services on people's fundamental rights; public institutions may give preference to products and services that have undergone an impact assessment.
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제35조.evidenceHint: AI impact assessment report (EV-IA) · Tests: T-BIAS, T-UX

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제40조.title: Fact-finding investigation and corrective orders
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제40조.description: Where a violation of the Act is suspected, the Minister of Science and ICT may conduct a fact-finding investigation and order the violating operator to suspend or correct the conduct and take other necessary measures.
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제40조.evidenceHint: Investigation response records, corrective-action implementation records (EV-AUDIT, EV-COMM)

KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제36조.title: Designation of a domestic representative
KR_AI_BASIC_ACT|제36조.description: Foreign operators above a defined threshold without an address or place of business in Korea must designate a domestic representative to perform safety- and trustworthiness-related duties on their behalf.
